description: Single source of truth that maps prompt-ids to validator phases for diagnostics and final acceptance. Consumed by tooling/record-prompt-execution.sh and tooling/validate.sh. Prompts in scopedChecks run validate.sh --check-prompt <id> before the recorder writes completed progress. Prompt 10 remains the hard final acceptance gate: source validation (--mode final-source; full static + build + catalog phases) followed by report-contract validation (--mode report). Since v1.2.0 this file also carries the validationRegistry block: per-phase metadata (domains, severity, alwaysRun, file/pattern triggers, cost, requiredForFinal) for manual/maintainer incremental validation experiments. Incremental validation never substitutes for prompt-10 source/report gates.

requiresSchema.comment: Hybrid requires[] — prompt 10 fullSweep gates are recorder-enforced today. requires[] entries on scopedChecks are prerequisite metadata for agents/diagnostics, not intermediate recorder hard gates. Future kinds (e.g. callSitesClosed) may be added without breaking consumers that ignore unknown kinds.

domainClosed.semantics: Every executionPlan call site for domain has disposition migrated|removed, or domain is not-applicable, or a valid deferredDomains[] entry exists.

allApplicableDomainsClosed.semantics: Prompt 10 only — every applicable executionPlan domain is closed or valid deferral.

backgroundAuthorizeDecisionsCaptured.semantics: Every bootstrap.processModel.backgroundEntryPoints[] candidate has a matching entry in bootstrap.backgroundAuthorize.decisions[] (intent ∈ {migrate, deferred, not-applicable}). Used by prompt 10 to ensure prompt 03c actually captured per-candidate developer intent.

auxProcessGdReachClosed.semantics: Prompt 10 only — closes PROC-AUX-001 findings. When auxiliary-process components can reach GD file APIs, each hit must be resolved in code (guard/remove) or explicitly closed in migration-report.json unverifiedSurfaces[] with pattern PROC-AUX-001 and a non-open status.

00pre.description: Bootstrap contract guard (schema + UEM + provenance/generatedAt invariant)

01.description: Gradle integration (settings.gradle / app build.gradle) — dependency/repository check

03c.description: Background Authorize wiring — interactive end-of-migration step. Presents bootstrap.processModel.backgroundEntryPoints[] candidates to the developer, captures per-candidate intent (migrate | deferred | not-applicable) into bootstrap.backgroundAuthorize.decisions[] only (agent must not edit deferredDomains[]), and applies the canonical pattern only to migrate-intent entries. Runs after prompts 04–09 so the developer can see which secure surfaces background entry points would touch.

04.description: SQLite migration + redundant-crypto removal + API audit

05a.description: Core file I/O writers/readers (subset of Phase 4) — includes stream-layer closure checks (kotlin.io / java.nio.file / FileReader / BitmapFactory.decodeFile / sandbox-seeded GD File) per steering/40-secure-file-storage.md §5 when run via validate.sh --check-prompt 05a. Prompt 10 remains the hard recorder gate.

05b.description: UI/library reader closure (subset of Phase 4) — includes the stream-layer closure checks above when run via validate.sh --check-prompt 05b so readers (readText/readBytes/FileReader/Files.readAllBytes/decodeFile) can be diagnosed before prompt 10.

08.description: ICC / TransferFileService + chooser-bypass + FileProvider manifest/resource hygiene audit

09.description: Secure UI widgets (GDEditText / GDTextView) and secureClipboard (platform + Compose GDClipboardAdapter)

11.description: Push Channel and FCM hardening — metadata-only FCM payloads, PushChannel wiring, Phase 12 FCM authorization gate

10.description: Final migration validation: all static phases + Gradle build + migration-report.json contract + API catalog cross-check

validationRegistry.comment: Per-phase metadata for validation planning. Consumed by tooling/lib/resolve-domains.py and tooling/validate.sh --mode incremental|full|final|final-source|report. The recorder orchestrates scopedChecks prompt gates and prompt-10 split gates (final-source then report). The --mode / --domains / --explain-plan / --list-checks flags on validate.sh are agent/maintainer debugging affordances only. SAFETY: prompt 10 always runs source+report acceptance gates regardless of this block.

crossCutting.comment: A change to any of these forces the broad domain set (every domain phase + every alwaysRun phase, still excluding expensiveFullOnly/reportOnly). Project-specific shared utility classes cannot be enumerated here; the recorder's prompt-owned phases plus the mandatory prompt-10 full sweep cover those.
